_comment: Used by lib/scorer.js to decide which resume to use for a job. Pass 1 is a title keyword match. Pass 2 cross-checks with skill-keyword overlap; if they disagree, the job is flagged for manual review instead of a silent guess. This file is the only place CV file names live: the pipeline, the Approve button and the dashboard all read it. Put the PDFs in resumes/ with exactly these names. Pointing two categories at the same file is fine.
notes: fullstack is the default resume (general software engineer roles). Order matters for titles: devops_cloud is checked first, then backend, then fullstack, so 'Senior Platform Engineer' picks the DevOps CV and 'Python Software Engineer' picks the Backend CV.
